rationale: For an enterprise SaaS dashboard managing finances and subscriptions, the user needs a command-center feel. Dark mode with high contrast ensures legibility, reduces eye strain for power users, and signals authority. The blue/green palette is adapted to high-visibility neon tones for quick scanning.

layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strictly left-aligned for data and labels. Right-aligned for monetary values (INR). Optical alignment for icons.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (#14151C), 1px solid border (#1E202B), no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-lg and brightens border.
surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-[#14151C]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Sticky top with z-50.
surface_strategies.sidebar: Solid dark background (#090A0F) with right border (#1E202B).
surface_strategies.radius: rounded-sm (4px) globally for a technical, crisp aesthetic.

buttons.primary: bg-[#3B82F6] text-white rounded-sm px-6 py-2 hover:bg-[#60A5FA] hover:text-white transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#334155] text-[#F8FAFC] rounded-sm px-6 py-2 hover:bg-[#1A1B24] hover:text-white transition-colors

forms.input: bg-[#090A0F] border border-[#1E202B] rounded-sm text-[#F8FAFC] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3B82F6] focus:border-transparent

tables.header: bg-[#090A0F] text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#64748B] border-b border-[#1E202B]

charts.tooltip: bg-[#14151C] border border-[#1E202B] shadow-xl rounded-sm p-3 text-[#F8FAFC]

motion.list_stagger: staggered entrance for table rows and metric cards

icons.style: Regular or Duotone for active states

accessibility.contrast: All text passes minimum 4.5:1 ratio on background. Alert colors tested for colorblind visibility.

login_background.description: Abstract geometric pattern of dark blue cubes
login_background.usage: Background image for the Login/Register authentication pages.

brand_logo.usage: Placeholder logo in the sidebar/header navigation.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST use 'data-testid' following kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='sidebar-nav-dashboard').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use custom HTML/Tailwind for the Control Room Grid layout. Do NOT overuse Shadcn Card components; prefer raw divs with specified flat borders and backgrounds for maximum density control.
Implement the specific alert logic for Subscriptions: green (active), yellow (due < 7 days), orange (due < 3 days), red (overdue).
Format all currency values in INR (₹) and right-align those columns in the data tables.
Use Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Configure Tailwind to load these fonts.
Enforce strictly Dark Theme. Do not build a theme toggle.
Forms for Add/Edit Subscription should be handled via Shadcn Dialog (Modal) to maintain dashboard context without navigating away.
All navigation must reside in a left sidebar. Top header should only contain context/profile info and use the Crystal Glassmorphism style.
